title: Format Hints Test
description: Testing markdown format hints with inline code, bold, italics, and links

entries.content: Show **working tree** status. Use `-s` for short format.
Save changes to repository. Use `git commit -m "message"` for inline message.
Show *commit* history. See [Git docs](https://git-scm.com/docs/git-log) for more options.
Show changes between commits. Supports **multiple modes**: `--staged`, `--cached`, and `HEAD~1..HEAD`.
Install dependencies from `package.json`. Use **`--save-dev`** for dev dependencies.
Execute a script defined in *package.json*. Commonly used: `npm run build` and `npm run test`.
